recipients.description: List of recipient email addresses (-t). Must have at least one if no cc/bcc provided.

body.default: This is a test email sent via sendemail.
body.description: Message body text (-m). Ignored if message_file is set.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host and port (-s). Format: host:port

smtp_user.description: SMTP authentication username (-xu). Leave empty if not used.

smtp_pass.description: SMTP authentication password (-xp). Leave empty if not used.

attachments.description: List of file paths to attach (-a)

use_local_sendmail.description: Use local sendmail utility instead of network MTA (-S)

local_sendmail_path.description: Path to local sendmail utility if use_local_sendmail is true (-S path)

message_file.description: Path to message file to use as body instead of inline body (-o message-file). If set, body is ignored.

auto_tls.description: Automatically start TLS if supported by server. (-o tls=auto)
